newsitem.title: USA: Owens-Illinois refinancing to help growth.
newsitem.headline: Owens-Illinois refinancing to help growth.

text.p: Owens-Illinois Inc said Thursday that its refinancing plan has given it added flexibility for its growth strategy.

The company is refinancing about $1.9 billion of public indebtedness. The plan is being funded by about $1 billion from the issuance of 16.9 million shares of common stock and offerings of senior notes, combined with added borrowings under an amended bank credit facility.

"When completed, the refinancing plan is expected to be accretive to earnings per share. However, because the retirement of the higher-coupon outstanding debt began late in the second quarter, with additional issues scheduled to be redeemed later in the year, the effect of the plan on second quarter earnings per share was slightly dilutive," the company said.

The company recorded extraordinary aftertax charges of $84.5 million in the second quarter 1997 for the early retirement of debt as part of the refinancing plan. Net earnings after the charges were $2.4 million, or $0.02 per share.
Earnings before extraordinary items were $0.66 per share in the second quarter 1997, compared with $0.55 per share in the second quarter 1996.
"As a result of our successful refinancing plan, we now have additional financial flexibility to pursue our strategy for expansion in growing markets," the company said.
